cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Apologize Properly
cards.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your apology email needs a subject line mentioning the broken vase.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll help you word it. Put 'vase' after 'sorry.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send 'Sorry about the vase' to Mum. She still thinks you broke it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with 'I broke the vase.' I'll handle her reply after she's read that.

reason: Replace the font jab and name-out slogan with actual wording help and a first-line admission; A takes the reply burden after the false blame is corrected.
